_note: UNVERIFIED SAMPLE NUMBERS. Working assumptions for the v0 'forecast by action' design, not checked against trial papers. Every value needs a check against the published trials (and a clinician's review for Rx options) before launch. low/mid/high bracket what we assume; the app shows the spread as a range.

slows._doc: Fraction by which the option slows the rate of progression, at full adherence. Changes the slope of the line.

grows._doc: Lift in Norwood stages while used, at full adherence. Same slope. Reaches full effect after onset_months, fades over fade_months after stopping. Options in the same group don't stack (topical and oral minoxidil).

chance_margin._doc: Added either side of a Norwood 3 chance before it is shown as a range, for model calibration error. An assumption.
